He turned the paper over twice, found no date and no name, and stood a long while listening to the sea, which said nothing at all.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有醒透。高架桥上的路灯一盏接一盏地熄，像有人沿着长街慢慢吹灭一排蜡烛。洒水车贴着路缘驶过，水痕在柏油上亮了几秒，又被干燥的夜风抹平。二十四小时便利店的白光里，店员正把新到的牛奶摆上货架，玻璃门上的雾气被他一掌抹开。远处有环卫工推着车，扫帚划过地面的声音一下一下，很慢，很有耐心。写字楼还有几扇窗亮着，格子间里有人盯着屏幕，杯子里的茶早已凉透。天边浮起一层极淡的青灰，像一块布从城市头顶缓缓揭开。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job does one small piece of itself and then hands the rest to a smaller copy of the same job, like a row of nesting dolls.\n- Every recursion needs a stopping point, a smallest case where there is nothing left to hand off — that's the floor at the bottom of the stairs.\n- If you forget the stopping point, the copies keep asking for more copies forever and the computer runs out of room, so always ask: where does this end?"}
